column1: # VibeOS security toolkit manifest — read by vibed's `sectools.list` (T0).
# Tier = the VibeOS capability tier that gates AGENT invocation of the tool
# (T0 passive/read, T1 local, T2 active-against-target [human approval],
# T3 destructive/high-risk [human approval]). The human operator uses these
# freely in the shell; the tier governs the (Phase 4) AI-invocation path.
# Keep in strict sync with os/Containerfile (layer 1d-bis) and
# docs/SECURITY-TOOLKIT.md. Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.

column4: DNS lookups (bind-utils): resolve records, zone data
DNS enumeration + zone-transfer / brute against a target
Port/service/OS scanning + NSE scripts against a target
Netcat: arbitrary TCP/UDP connections, listeners, relays
Packet capture/analysis on a local interface
Wireshark CLI: capture and dissect traffic
Crafted TCP/IP packets, port scanning, path probing
Replay captured traffic onto a network
Discover hosts via ARP on the local segment
Scan NetBIOS name information on a network
View/change a local interface MAC address
Force any TCP tool through a proxy chain
Fingerprint web technologies of a target site
Online brute-force of network login services
Offline password hash cracking (John the Ripper)
Wi-Fi WEP/WPA analysis and key recovery suite
Trace system calls of a local process
Trace library calls of a local process
Modify ELF interpreter/rpath of a binary
Report binary hardening (RELRO, NX, PIE, canary)
Impacket suite: SMB/AD network protocol tooling
Sleuth Kit: list files in a disk image
Hide/extract data in images and audio (steganography)
